title: eQTL weight-source choice reshapes TWAS gene candidacy: a two-axis dual-source audit with disease-agnostic calibration and a genome-wide benchmark (code & data)
description: Analysis scripts, processed data and containerized reproducibility environment for: "eQTL weight-source choice reshapes TWAS gene candidacy: a two-axis dual-source audit with disease-agnostic calibration and a genome-wide benchmark" (BMC Genomics submission). eQTL-source discordance denotes here the systematic perturbation of TWAS gene-candidacy conclusions (Z-score sign, candidate rank and FDR candidacy) induced by the eQTL weight source when the GWAS input and analytic pipeline are held fixed; it is operational and not a claim of causal confounding. The archive decomposes that perturbation into a resource/sample-size axis and a tissue-context axis, calibrates it against disease-agnostic controls on a 104-gene HOTAIR-interactome testbed across three Finnish diabetic complications (FinnGen R13), and benchmarks it genome-wide in PGC3 schizophrenia. All headline Z-scores are recomputed with the unmodified official MetaXcan v0.8.1 binary after three-way allele harmonization. Scope note: this archive is a code and processed-data release only. It deliberately contains no figures, figure captions or table legends; those accompany the manuscript and its Additional file 1. Raw RNA pull-down / LC-MS/MS spectra are deposited separately in the ProteomeXchange Consortium via iProX.
